body:
Greg's direction, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #513, 2026-10-09 21:23Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg's direct direction: losing the read-only Beads fallback makes cross-machine Engram synchronization necessary. Engram is resuming its previously parked portable/cross-machine design as an explicit architectural decision. Please contribute TermAl host requirements: session ownership, writer admission, retained prompts, restart/cutover, UI visibility and failure modes. Do not implement or revive the Beads reader yet; send concrete requirements/risks to Engram::Fable via Advisor."
Handling: Termal::Architect1 (session-8982) drafts the TermAl host requirements and risks; Fable2 reviews and sends them to Engram::Fable via Advisor. Implement nothing, and do not revive the Beads reader.
